name: BUNNYBLACK
source:
Darks is a perverted adventurer entered a labyrinth known as the Maou’s forest and was defeated by the maou himself. But taking pity on him, the maou kindly recruited him as part of this demon army. Given a second chance, Darks has two goals: to rise in the ranks of the demon army, and to defeat and have sex with those girls who come to attack the maou.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
达克斯是一名变态冒险家，进入了名为魔王森林的迷宫，并被魔王本人击败。但魔王怜悯他，善意地将他招募为魔族大军的一员。如果有第二次机会，达克斯有两个目标：在恶魔大军中崛起，并击败那些前来攻击魔王的女孩并与其发生性关系。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
